t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The success of this task hinges on your ability to recognize the pattern between which coloured gnomes lead you to which forest type (bright or dark), and to ignore any other differential characteristics the gnomes may have.

vb_textbox.text: To keep this short and sweet your success in this game relies on your ability to be patient and recognize patterns within a short and snappy timeframe (1.5s per round). Gnomes will appear in pairs and picking a certain colour will lead you to either a dark forest or a bright forest. For me I'm not sure if either forest leads to more mushrooms but you may recognize a pattern if you're super attentive.
